maddeler.e:
استصحبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَصْحَبُوا (istaṣḥabū) /is.tasˤ.ħa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# اُسْتُصْحِبُوا (ustuṣḥibū) /us.tusˤ.ħi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# اِسْتَصْحِبُوا (istaṣḥibū) /is.tasˤ.ħi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
